title: Kubuno conformance vector suite (format 1)
description: One suite of conformance vectors: inputs and the outputs every implementation of a shared algorithm must produce. See vskubuno docs/SHARED-CORES.md, section 'SC-0 as built'.

format.description: File format major version. Runners refuse a format they do not know.

version.description: SemVer of the suite. MAJOR: an expected output changed or a case was removed. MINOR: cases added. PATCH: notes and descriptions only.

reference.description: The reference implementation the expected outputs come from (crate and function).

id.description: Unique within the suite; slash-separated groups are allowed (equals/case-insensitive).

input.description: Any JSON value; its shape is defined by the suite.

expected.description: Any JSON value. Unordered results are emitted sorted by the producer.

skip.description: Known, documented divergences: platform -> reason. The runner of that platform reports the case as skipped.
